items.information:
### [FR]

Il s'agit d'un championnat québécois de **résolution optimisée et de résolution multiple à l'aveugle** organisé par [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org).

Seules deux épreuves officielles de la WCA auront lieu lors de cette compétition : le **3x3x3 résolution optimisée (FMC)** et le **3x3x3 résolution multiple à l'aveugle**. Cette compétition ne comporte pas d'épreuves de vitesse.

Il ne s'agit pas d'une compétition typique où il faut résoudre le plus vite possible :

- **3x3x3 résolution optimisée** : une **épreuve de type examen** au cours de laquelle les compétiteurs passent jusqu'à une heure à trouver la solution la plus courte possible et à **l'écrire sur papier**.
- **3x3x3 résolution multiple à l'aveugle** : les compétiteurs mémorisent puis résolvent plusieurs cubes à l'aveugle, avec une limite de temps de 10 minutes par cube (jusqu'à un maximum d'une heure).

Il est conseillé aux nouveaux participants de lire les articles [B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#article-B-blindfolded) et [E](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#article-E-fewest-moves) du règlement de la WCA. Si vous cherchez à participer à une compétition de speedcubing plus classique, merci de chercher [une autre compétition au Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada).

### Avis de droit à l'image
Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans le cadre de la promotion de ses activités, notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

---

### [EN]

This is a Quebec **Fewest Moves and Multi-Blind** Championship organized by [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org).

Only two official WCA events will be held at this competition: **3x3x3 Fewest Moves (FMC)** and **3x3x3 Multi-Blind**. This competition does not feature speedsolving events.

This isn't your typical speedsolving competition:

- **3x3x3 Fewest Moves**: an **exam-style event** in which competitors spend up to an hour finding the shortest solution they can and **writing it down on paper**.
- **3x3x3 Multi-Blind**: competitors memorize and then solve multiple cubes blindfolded, with a time limit of 10 minutes per cube (up to a maximum of one hour).

Competitors who are new to these events are advised to read Articles [B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#article-B-blindfolded) and [E](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#article-E-fewest-moves) of the WCA Regulations. If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 speedsolving event or other timed events, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada).

### Notice of Filming and Photography
Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information:
# REGISTRO 🇧🇷
**A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos:**

* Conhecer as regras da WCA, pois é uma competição oficial;
* Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Preste atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites;
* Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$20,00 pagos antecipadamente via PIX. Não serão aceitas inscrições no dia do campeonato. **PIX: renan.cunha20@gmail.com**
* Enviar comprovante de pagamento para o e-mail renan.cunha20@gmail.com. **Inscrições so serão confirmadas após o envio do comprovante.**
* Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (umberto.santos@sesisp.org.br), bem como o delegado por meio do e-mail (mcasassa@worldcubeassociation.org).

OBS.: Alunos do SESI SANTOS estão isentos da taxa de insrição, mas devem Informar que são alunos do SESI no campo INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS durante o ato da inscrição.

# REGISTRATION 🇬🇧
**The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements:**

* Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition;
* Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind.
* Register through the WCA website.The registration fee is R$20,00 paid in advance via PIX. Registration at competition day will not be allowed. **PIX: renan.cunha20@gmail.com**
* Send proof of payment to renan.cunha20@gmail.com. **Registrations must be confirmed after sending the voucher.**
* For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (umberto.santos@sesisp.org.br), or the delegate via email (mcasassa@worldcubeassociation.org).

OBS.: SESI SANTOS students are exempt from the registration fee, but they must inform that they are SESI students in the ADDITIONAL INFORMATION field during registration.
